title: Island with a palm tree with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ocean water -->
  <rect x="0" y="72" width="100" height="28" fill="#2aa9c9"/>
  <rect x="0" y="72" width="100" height="4" fill="#7fe0f0"/>
  <!-- small waves -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="85" rx="10" ry="2.5" fill="#5ccfe0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="90" rx="12" ry="3" fill="#5ccfe0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="96" rx="9" ry="2" fill="#5ccfe0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- island sand -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="30" ry="10" fill="#f3d17c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="71" rx="24" ry="7" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <!-- palm tree trunk -->
  <path d="M48 70 Q46 56 50 44 Q54 34 56 28" stroke="#b5762a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- trunk shading -->
  <path d="M50 70 Q48 56 52 44" stroke="#e0a850" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- palm leaves -->
  <path d="M56 28 Q70 20 82 24 Q72 26 60 32 Z" fill="#3cb043"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q68 12 78 10 Q72 20 60 30 Z" fill="#4fce5d"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q44 10 32 12 Q42 20 52 30 Z" fill="#3cb043"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q36 18 24 26 Q38 26 52 32 Z" fill="#4fce5d"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q46 36 40 46 Q50 38 56 34 Z" fill="#2f9e38"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q66 34 78 42 Q66 38 58 34 Z" fill="#2f9e38"/>
  <!-- coconuts -->
  <circle cx="53" cy="34" r="3" fill="#8b5a1e"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="33" r="3" fill="#a06a24"/>
  <!-- smiling face on trunk -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="50" r="2.2" fill="#4a2e0c"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="50" r="2.2" fill="#4a2e0c"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="47.7" cy="49.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <circle cx="53.7" cy="49.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 55 Q50 61 56 55" stroke="#4a2e0c" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="54" r="2" fill="#e88a7a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="54" r="2" fill="#e88a7a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- little sun -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="8" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <g stroke="#ffe14d" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="18" y1="3" x2="18" y2="0"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="29" x2="18" y2="32"/>
    <line x1="5" y1="16" x2="2" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="31" y1="16" x2="34" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="9" y1="7" x2="7" y2="5"/>
    <line x1="27" y1="7" x2="29" y2="5"/>
    <line x1="9" y1="25" x2="7" y2="27"/>
    <line x1="27" y1="25" x2="29" y2="27"/>
  </g>
</svg>
